mentions.name: bopbop.dev
mentions.description: Chrome extension that lets AI agents such as Claude Code, Codex, and others control the user's browser, with a bundled skill/MCP to connect to it. The author built it after finding browser agents slow and token-inefficient, and has used it daily for a month in place of Claude in Chrome.
mentions.problem: Browser agents are slow and inefficient with tokens; with token prices expected to rise, the author wanted to use tokens more efficiently when agents do web tasks.
mentions.audience: People working with coding agents like Claude Code and Codex who want faster, more token-efficient browser use
mentions.source_excerpt:
I made https://bopbop.dev to control browser and do same things faster and with less tokens.

It is a Chrome extension that lets Claude Code, Codex or other agents use your browser. Comes with a skill/mcp to connect to it.
